data.name: Barrel Chess
data.detailed_description:
Chess just lost its edges. So did whatever confidence you're bringing to this.

Barrel Chess fuses 4 standard chessboards into one open barrel, joined edge-to-edge so there's no seam where the board actually ends. Same pieces. Same rules you learned as a kid. But slide anything sideways far enough and it doesn't stop at an edge - because there isn't one. It crosses clean onto the next board, then the next, looping all the way around the barrel if nothing catches it first. A rook you thought was trapped can suddenly attack from a direction that shouldn't exist. A king you thought was safe isn't, because "safe" on a normal board just doesn't mean the same thing here.

Corner checkmates? Gone. There's nothing left to trap a king against. No walls, no corners, nowhere for your opponent to hide, and nowhere for you to hide either. So all that "I'm good at endgames" confidence you've built up on a normal board? Worthless here. You're starting from zero, same as everyone else who thought they understood chess.

Face down BarrelBot, running on real Stockfish - one of the strongest chess engines on Earth, now forced to babysit 4 boards at once because apparently one wasn't enough of a beating for you. 4 difficulty tiers, and yes, Easy exists. We recommend it.

Customize the board, the pieces, the background - dress it up however you like. Won't change how badly you lose.

Features:

  • A Genuine Chess Variant - Same rules, zero new pieces, your entire strategy in ruins anyway.

  • BarrelBot v3.0 - 4 Stockfish-powered difficulty tiers, built to remind you exactly where you stand.

  • Full Customization - Pick your colors before BarrelBot picks you apart.

  • Multiplayer - For when you want a human to watch you lose too.

  • Local - Play against your "friend", side by side. Don't rage too much.

data.short_description: Four chessboards. One barrel. Every "safe" square you know is a lie here. Chess just lost its edges, and so did your confidence. Four boards fused into one barrel. Same rules, no walls, nowhere to trap a king. Face BarrelBot, running real Stockfish Engine across all 4 boards.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4th Gen / AMD equivalent (dual-core, 2.0 GHz+)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or equivalent) / any dedicated GPU with 1 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8th Gen / AMD Ryzen 5 equivalent (quad-core, 2.5 GHz+)
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio
